data.summary: Netflix (NFLX) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: In addition, new technological developments, including the development and use of generative AI, are rapidly evolving.

For example, the development and use of generative AI tools remain subject to uncertain legal frameworks, and the availability of copyright and other intellectual property protection for AI-generated material is uncertain.
